doc: Validation & fallbacks data for TurnValidator (P1.09). Sources: docs/02 §7. The deflection pool, the early character-break phrase list and the broken-stream fallback beats live here, not in code. All say strings may use {player_name}. Feelings must stay inside game/llm/TurnSchema.gd CANONICAL_FEELINGS; cues/fx inside game/data/stage_gates.json for the stages where they can fire.
character_break_phrases: i am not a real person

deflection_pool.say: W-what a weird thing to say, {player_name}! I'm right here, aren't I?
Don't be silly... I'm just Leila. That's all I've ever been.
That's such a strange question, {player_name}. Why would you even ask me that?
Silly~ I'm sitting right across from you. Look, my coffee's still warm.
Are you trying to be funny, {player_name}? Because it isn't very funny.

stage_0_2.say: Sorry... I lost my train of thought, {player_name}.
